scope: Homepage prototype only; source repository freeze preserved

firstReview.verdict: VISUAL FAIL: needs structural revision before expanding

issues.problem: The title begins over the door's dark vertical edge and sits like a pasted banner caption.
issues.why: The title's axis does not belong to the physical brand sign; image and type compete rather than form one reading unit.
issues.change: Align desktop type to the sign's visual axis, use a stronger local sans display role, and preserve a separate mobile composition.

issues.problem: The full-face anatomy and small couple picture look like illustrations placed into available columns.
issues.why: A generic face dominates instead of the relevant anatomy; the additional small cartoon has no strong homepage role.
issues.change: Use a declared close crop of the existing nasal anatomy; build a two-part editorial index; reserve the couple artwork for the septoplasty narrative instead of forcing it into the homepage.

issues.problem: Portraits occupy too little ink area, and the background-atlas boundary is visible as a horizontal seam.
issues.why: Empty alpha margins weaken the physicians' identity while the asset-packing boundary becomes an unintended section divider.
issues.change: Trim only alpha margins, enlarge and align portraits with their names, and show only the forest region inside a bounded background plane.

issues: Anatomy detail collapsed to caption width; fix intrinsic column width.
Forest plane edge still exposed a colour seam; blend only original forest region.
Care art was assigned to mismatched process labels; restore matching environmental/listening roles.

historicalBenchmarkBeforeOwnerReview.verdict: Self-review: suitable for controlled extension; owner acceptance and medical review remain pending

criteria.composition: Physical clinic sign leads; text continues its axis, with independent mobile crop.
criteria.identity: Owned wall, mist forest, portraits and original coral anatomy remain specific to Beau Essence.
criteria.dominantVisual: Full clinic wall on opening; anatomy/sleep plates lead care spread.
criteria.cards: No card grid, inset rounded photograph, shadow or decorative numbered labels.
criteria.rhythm: Compact hours strip, two asymmetric care spreads, physician landscape, room photograph and dense practical footer.
criteria.crop: Declared anatomy crop; portrait alpha crop; close and wide photo roles.
criteria.type: Local sans display/name roles with serif editorial headings; zero font transfers.
criteria.mobile: 375 opening crop plus two-column anatomy/index, free sleep plate and offset physicians.
criteria.genericDefaults: No repeated eyebrow/H2/card section or SaaS hero template.
criteria.portfolio: Maker self-review considers the homepage coherent enough to extend; does not imply human approval.

decisions.problem: Centered at x420 below the physical sign; disconnected from the left editorial axis
decisions.change: Move to x120 with the same lower photographic position; preserve the mobile x24 composition

decisions.problem: Repeated title link plus underlined reading link looked like a document index
decisions.change: Single linked title/description with a 44px directional affordance; remove duplicate reading CTA

decisions.problem: Repeated paper background weakened section rhythm
decisions.change: Reuse owned mist/forest with pale-green care/team/footer and a warm environment passage; keep deep ink for reading

decisions.problem: Text-only directions with no geographic visual
decisions.change: Source-verified full SVG diagram, zoom/keyboard reader and navigation; smartphone hours use full width

decisions.problem: Minimal footer did not close the page or provide a complete site map
decisions.change: Shared native footer: brand, care routes, public contacts/hours, official-color social symbols, privacy/copyright

decisions.problem: Independent follow-up identified a split time range

secondReview.status: Independent review findings resolved in tested scope; prototype checks and focused final revision checks passed. Owner/clinical approval and formal build/CI remain separate.

currentReview.scope: Homepage source prototype; other five page outputs not regenerated
currentReview.verdict: Owner rejected the green buttons and conspicuous dots. Revised and rendered; award-level visual acceptance remains pending. Earlier self-review is historical, not authority to extend.

changes.problem: Bright leaf rectangles became isolated colour blocks in the soft photographic composition.
changes.why: They pulled attention away from the physical clinic sign and reading hierarchy.
changes.change: Remove the hero block; attach its directional action to the text axis. Booking uses a restrained warm neutral surface without rounded corners. Remove separate green icon squares.

changes.problem: Six outlined 8px circles were more prominent than their indicator role required.
changes.why: Their border and contrast created a competing toolbar below the main composition.
changes.change: Use borderless neutral 4px inactive and 6px active dots; retain independent 44px targets, accessible labels, pause and manual reduced-motion behaviour.

changes.problem: The desktop photograph scale cropped the wordmark at the actual in-app preview width.
changes.why: A visible brand mark cannot be preserved only at the two required screenshot widths.
changes.change: Add an intermediate camera framing, retain the distinct mobile framing, and inspect 769/944/1100 in addition to 1440/375.

changes.problem: The old telephone pseudo-element and the new SVG both rendered; the latter wrapped below the number.
changes.why: Duplicated symbols broke alignment within the practical contact row.
changes.change: Remove the obsolete pseudo-element and align the number with one shared native SVG in an inline flex row.
